# getPerson — GET /people/{vanId}

Get a person by VAN id

## Verified behaviors

- **Related collections are null until $expand asks for them** — Emails, phones and addresses come back null — not empty — unless the request names them in $expand. Expanded, a section the person actually has is an array of entries and a section they lack is an empty array, so null always means 'not requested', never 'none'. ([replay](../behaviors/person-collections-null-until-expanded.md))
- **$expand values are policed, and two valid ones are refused here** — A value outside the documented set is refused with INVALID_PARAMETER and a hint listing every valid value. Two values inside the set are still refused in a My Campaign context: `scores` with 403 and `pollingLocation` with 400. ([replay](../behaviors/person-expand-set-is-policed.md))
- **Unknown ids 404 with the envelope; a non-integer id gets HTML** — An unknown, zero or negative vanId returns the standard 404 error envelope. A path segment that is not an integer never reaches the handler — the route does not match, and the answer is an HTML 404 page instead. ([replay](../behaviors/person-unknown-ids-404-two-ways.md))

## Behavior

Retrieves a person record. Related collections (emails, phones, addresses, …) are null unless requested via $expand, and empty arrays when expanded but absent. An unknown, zero, or negative vanId returns the standard 404 error envelope; a non-integer path segment does not match the route and returns an HTML 404 page instead.

## Differs from the official docs

- **parameters / vanId** — Official docs type this path parameter as string (default "100476252"); the route only matches integers — a non-integer segment returns an IIS HTML 404 page (observed 2026-08-03).
- **parameters / $expand** — Official docs list only 10 valid $expand values; the API's own INVALID_PARAMETER hint (observed 2026-08-03) lists these 23.

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X GET \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/102714507?$expand=['emails', 'phones', 'addresses']' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1"
```

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vanId` * | integer (int32) | VAN id of the person. |

`*` = required.

## Query parameters

| Name | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$expand` | array of string | Related sections to include, comma-delimited eg 'addresses,emails'. Anything outside this set returns 400 INVALID_PARAMETER with a hint listing the valid values. Two sections in the set are still refused in a My Campaign context: `scores` with 403 FORBIDDEN and `pollingLocation` with 400 BAD_REQUEST. One of: `addresses`, `biography`, `cases`, `codes`, `contributionHistory`, `customFields`, `customProperties`, `disclosureFieldValues`, `districts`, `electionRecords`, `emails`, `externalIds`, `membershipStatuses`, `notes`, `organizationRoles`, `phones`, `pollingLocation`, `preferences`, `primaryContact`, `recordedAddresses`, `reportedDemographics`, `scores`, `suppressions`. |

`*` = required.
